text: メノクラゲに　さされないよう　きを　つけて　およげよ！

structure.jp: メノクラゲに　さされないよう
structure.en: so you don't get stung by Tentacool

patterns.name: 〜ないように
patterns.explanation: ないよう(に) after a verb says what you are trying to keep from happening. さされないよう = 'so that you don't get stung'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.span: メノクラゲに　さされない
patterns.explanation: The される ending turns 'sting' into 'be stung', and に shows who does the stinging. メノクラゲに　さされない = 'not get stung by Tentacool'.

patterns.name: 〜ろ (command)
patterns.explanation: Changing the last う sound of a verb to え makes a blunt order, softened a little here by よ. およげ = 'swim!'.
